notes: The circuit image's lettered rows run j-f above the centre gap and e-a below it; I mapped the upper half to bank 'b' (rows f-j) and the lower half to bank 't' (rows a-e) to match the catalogue naming. The top rail with the red + line is 'tp' and the lower rail is 'bn'. Exact rail hole numbers are approximate; each rail is one strip so connectivity is unaffected.

Each button's top pair of legs (side 1) goes to 5V via a red jumper; its bottom pair (side 2) carries the signal wire to the Leonardo pin and the 10k pulldown resistor to GND. Pin 6 = mouse click, 5 = right, 4 = left, 3 = down, 2 = up, per the sketch.
Resistor values are in ohms (10000 = 10k). The USB cable to the computer is mentioned in the text but is not a circuit part, so it is not in the graph.
